articles._summary: Wall Street economists can spend all day debating what the Federal Reserve might do, whether inflation is really defeated, and whether the economy is heading toward a soft landing, a hard landing, or some newly invented landing that gives television commentators another excuse to fill airtime. articles.author: Parshwa Turakhiya
articles.headline: Tom Lee's Bitmine Buys 9,946 ETH as ETH/BTC Ratio Hits 3-Month High
articles.summary: Bitmine buys 9,946 ETH as the ETH/BTC ratio hits a three-month high and BMNR tests key resistance near $18.
articles._summary: According to a Monday company update , Bitmine purchased 9,946 ETH worth roughly $19.4 million, lifting total holdings to 5,787,414 ETH worth $11.2 billion, or 4.8% of Ethereum’s entire circulating supply. The company also accelerated its share buyback, repurchasing 6.1 million shares compared to 5.5 million the week prior. Lee said the 11.6 million total shares repurchased since July 1 mark the largest common stock buyback ever executed by any ETH or Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) digital asset treasury.
articles._zh_headline: Tom Lee 的 Bitmine 买入 9,946 ETH，ETH/BTC 比率触及 3 个月高点
articles._zh_summary: 根据周一公司更新，Bitmine 购买了 9,946 个 ETH，价值约 1,940 万美元，使总持有量达到 5,787,414 个 ETH，价值 112 亿美元，占以太坊总流通量的 4.8%。该公司还加速了股票回购，回购了 610 万股，而前一周为 550 万股。 Lee 表示，自 7 月 1 日以来回购的股票总数为 1160 万股，这是 ETH 或比特币（CRYPTO：BTC）数字资产库有史以来执行的最大规模的普通股回购。

articles.author: Henry Khederian
articles.headline: Meta Platforms Stock Edges Higher Ahead of Earnings Test
articles.summary: With Big Tech’s AI and data-center spending back under the microscope, Meta Platforms faces a prove-it moment when it reports earnings on July 29—investors want evidence that heavier capex is translating into durable, cash-generative growth.
articles._summary: Wednesday’s print is a direct test of whether Meta can deliver strong ad-led growth while convincing the market its AI buildout won’t erode profitability and cash generation. The company has beat estimates in four consecutive quarters, with an average EPS surprise of +12.1%. Most recently (April 29, 2026), Meta delivered EPS of $7.31 versus a $6.67 estimate on revenue of $56.31 billion versus $55.54 billion, a pattern of out-earning expectations even when revenue surprises are modest.
articles._zh_headline: Meta Platforms 股票在盈利测试前走高
articles._zh_summary: 周三的印刷品是对 Meta 能否实现强劲的广告主导型增长，同时让市场相信其人工智能建设不会侵蚀盈利能力和现金生成的直接考验。该公司连续四个季度超出预期，平均每股收益超出预期+12.1%。最近（2026 年 4 月 29 日），Meta 的每股收益为 7.31 美元，而预期收入为 563.1 亿美元，而预期为 6.67 美元；营收为 555.4 亿美元，即使在收入意外不大的情况下，这种盈利模式也超出了预期。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: Alphabet Changed Wall Street’s Favorite AI Metric: Microsoft and Meta Are Up Next
articles.summary: Wall Street has a new AI obsession: CapEx. Alphabet, Microsoft and Meta are racing toward more than $1 trillion in annual AI infrastructure spending.
articles._summary: Investors used to judge AI stocks by three factors: revenue, earnings, and whether those figures beat Wall Street’s expectations. For the largest tech companies, that framework is rapidly becoming obsolete. Wall Street has become obsessed with a different line on the financial statements: capital expenditures, or capex. Investors now want to know something far more important: How many billions are they willing to spend to win the AI race?
articles._zh_headline: Alphabet 改变了华尔街最喜欢的人工智能指标：微软和 Meta 紧随其后
articles._zh_summary: 投资者过去常常通过三个因素来判断人工智能股票：收入、盈利以及这些数据是否超出华尔街的预期。对于最大的科技公司来说，这个框架正在迅速过时。华尔街已经开始痴迷于财务报表上的另一条线：资本支出或资本支出。投资者现在想知道一些更重要的事情：他们愿意花费多少亿美元来赢得人工智能竞赛？

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: This 100-Year-Old Theory Says the Stock Market Isn’t Done Climbing: Ed Yardeni
articles.summary: Yardeni says Dow Theory remains bullish as transportation stocks hit record highs, as the AI infrastructure boom supports the broader market.
articles._summary: Artificial intelligence has dominated Wall Street’s attention this year. Investors have obsessed over capital spending, shrinking free cash flow and whether the hyperscalers are overspending on AI. Yet one of the market’s oldest indicators is quietly telling a very different story. According to Ed Yardeni , a theory developed more than 100 years ago still suggests the bull market has further to run. “Dow Theory remains bullish,” Yardeni said in his latest sector outlook.
articles._zh_headline: 这个已有 100 年历史的理论表明股市的上涨还没有结束：埃德·亚德尼 (Ed Yardeni)
articles._zh_summary: 人工智能今年主导了华尔街的注意力。投资者一直关注资本支出、自由现金流萎缩以及超大规模企业是否在人工智能上过度支出。然而，市场最古老的指标之一正在悄然讲述一个截然不同的故事。 Ed Yardeni 认为，100 多年前发展起来的理论仍然表明牛市还会进一步运行。 “道琼斯指数仍然看涨，”亚德尼在最新的行业展望中表示。

articles.author: Surbhi Jain
articles.headline: EXCLUSIVE: After Nvidia And SK Hynix, These 3 AI Stocks Could Be The Next Winners, CEO Says
articles.summary: After Nvidia and SK Hynix, GraniteShares CEO Will Rhind says Broadcom, Marvell and TSMC could be the next AI winners.
articles._summary: “Follow the bottlenecks,” Rhind told Benzinga in an exclusive email interview. According to Rhind, the biggest investment opportunities are shifting from AI processors themselves to the technologies that connect, manufacture and support them. After GPUs and memory, Rhind sees networking infrastructure as one of the next critical constraints for AI data centers. “After the GPU and the memory, the next winners are the companies solving how you connect and power all of it,” he said.

articles._zh_summary: “追随瓶颈，”莱因德在独家电子邮件采访中告诉本辛加。 Rhind 表示，最大的投资机会正在从人工智能处理器本身转向连接、制造和支持它们的技术。 Rhind 认为，继 GPU 和内存之后，网络基础设施是人工智能数据中心的下一个关键限制之一。 “继 GPU 和内存之后，下一个赢家是那些解决如何连接和供电的公司，”他说。

articles.author: Stjepan Kalinic
articles.headline: Bond Markets Are Rethinking Big Tech’s $1 Trillion+ a Year for AI
articles.summary: Big Tech's AI capex boom is wiping out free cash flow. Discover how data center spending is changing tech investing forever.
articles._summary: “Investors are ​underestimating how fundamentally AI is changing the Big Tech business model,” Shay Boloor , chief market strategist at Futurum Equities , said, according to Reuters. “These companies were historically valued as asset-light platforms because ​revenue could scale much faster than capital requirements, but AI is pushing them toward a hybrid model where software, advertising and cloud economics increasingly depend on enormous physical infrastructure spending,” he added.
articles._zh_headline: 债券市场正在重新思考大型科技公司每年为人工智能投入超过 1 万亿美元的资金
articles._zh_summary: 据路透社报道，Futurum Equities 首席市场策略师 Shay Boloor 表示：“投资者低估了人工智能对大型科技商业模式的根本改变。”他补充道：“这些公司历来被视为轻资产平台，因为收入的增长速度可能远远快于资本需求，但人工智能正在推动它们走向一种混合模式，在这种模式中，软件、广告和云经济越来越依赖于巨大的物理基础设施支出。”

articles.author: Rishabh Mishra
articles.headline: Stock Market: Will S&P 500 Open Up or Down Today?
articles.summary: Polymarket S&P 500 up open odds hit 88% on July 27 as a pause in U.S. strikes on Iran sends crude oil prices tumbling.
articles._summary: U.S. stock futures are rising heading into Monday morning, driven by a temporary lull in Middle East hostilities and a steep pullback in global energy prices. Markets received a substantial boost over the weekend following news that the United States suspended its 13-night airstrike campaign against Iran to allow space for diplomatic negotiations and evaluate depleted munitions stocks.
articles._zh_headline: 股市：今天标普 500 指数会上涨还是下跌？
articles._zh_summary: 受中东敌对行动暂时平息和全球能源价格大幅回落的推动，美国股指期货周一上午上涨。周末有消息称，美国暂停对伊朗进行为期 13 晚的空袭行动，为外交谈判留出空间并评估耗尽的弹药库存，市场大幅提振。

articles.author: Badar Shaikh
articles.headline: Peter Schiff Says Elon Musk Lost $100 Billion Amid Tesla, SpaceX Selloff: 'I'm an Elon Fan'
articles.summary: Peter Schiff comments on Elon Musk's $100B loss in wealth due to Tesla and SpaceX stock declines, but clarifies he is not criticizing Musk.
articles._summary: In a series of posts on X on Friday, the Echelon Wealth Partners co-founder said that Musk lost nearly $100 billion in a week. “I’m old enough to remember when $100 billion was a lot of money,” he said. Schiff then responded to a user in the thread, who said that Musk was creating value for the world and that the dip was not permanent. “I’m an Elon fan,” Schiff said, adding that the post was not criticizing the Tesla CEO. “I wish I was rich enough to ‘lose’ $100 billion in one week,” he said.
articles._zh_headline: 彼得·希夫称埃隆·马斯克因特斯拉、SpaceX 抛售而损失了 1000 亿美元：“我是埃隆·马斯克的粉丝”
articles._zh_summary: 周五，这位 Echelon Wealth Partners 联合创始人在 X 上的一系列帖子中表示，马斯克在一周内损失了近 1000 亿美元。 “我已经足够大了，还记得 1000 亿美元是一笔巨款，”他说。希夫随后在帖子中回复了一位用户，该用户表示马斯克正在为世界创造价值，而且这种下滑并不是永久性的。 “我是埃隆的粉丝，”希夫说，并补充说该帖子并不是批评特斯拉首席执行官。 “我希望自己足够富有，能够在一周内‘损失’ 1000 亿美元，”他说。
